principles: Naming visible to OSS users must be self-explanatory — koala/omx labels confuse contributors
Codex CLI's mandatory lowercase .codex/ is a hard contract — never rename
Decision-doc edits are first-class: they go through the same 3x2 gate as code (per existing always-on policy)
Verify rename completion with a residual-zero grep, not by inspection
drivers: OSS launch must not ship unexplainable koala/omx legacy names
Case-insensitive filesystem (macOS default) makes .codex vs .Codex coexistence fragile
User explicitly does not want .omx polluting the workspace

options.name: Bundle all 3 (chosen)
pros: Shares the 3x2 escalation cost across all decision-doc edits
cons: Wider diff; one finding can hold up the whole story

options.name: Three separate stories
cons: Triple the 3x2 escalation effort; lab description fix is too small to justify a story

options.name: Skip omx, do 1+2 only
cons: Defers user-explicit omx removal request, requires another session

rationale: Items 2 and 3 both edit decision documents and would individually trigger 3x2 escalation; bundling shares the cost. The lab description fix is too small to justify its own story.

preMortem.scenario: The .Codex → .lattice-codex rename misses a reference, leaving a half-renamed system
preMortem.trigger: Relying on a single static grep for '.Codex/' which can miss variants like backticked path tokens or fixture execute strings
preMortem.consequence: Codex adapter at runtime can't find its assets; verify_codex breaks; e2e fails
preMortem.mitigation: Use two-pass scan: `git grep -nE '\.Codex(/|\b)'` AND search for backticks/string-template variants; residual-scan gate must hit zero; verify_codex 8/8 is required evidence

preMortem.scenario: The rename accidentally touches lowercase .codex/, breaking Codex CLI's native hook contract
preMortem.consequence: Codex CLI cannot find its hooks.json, breaks Codex usage entirely
preMortem.mitigation: All rename commands must be case-sensitive; an explicit guard intent must check .codex/hooks.json + .codex/hooks/lattice-scope-pretool.cjs still exist post-rename; verify_codex 8/8 must pass (it reads .codex/hooks.json)

preMortem.scenario: omx removal leaves the disable-guard test still wired, breaking CI
preMortem.trigger: Removing verify-omx-disabled.mjs but forgetting its `test:omx-disabled` entry in root package.json
preMortem.consequence: npm run test:omx-disabled fails on every run
preMortem.mitigation: Per-item adversarial intent: `grep test:omx-disabled package.json` returns nothing AND `ls scripts/verify-omx-disabled.mjs` errors

preMortem.scenario: Decision-doc edits hit the always-on 3x2 quorum gate at DONE; without preparation we get stuck
preMortem.trigger: Forgetting that decision-doc changes are gate-consumed
preMortem.consequence: DONE blocked; story can't merge to main
preMortem.mitigation: Pre-plan to use the user-approved degraded 3x1 fallback (memory: use-degraded-3x1-review-escalation); record review_escalation_fallback_set proactively if findings count ≥ 2 during round-1 REVIEW
